mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend over the past 3 months compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE has been above 4.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) over the past two months signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline > 1.0% and INDPRO decline > 0.5% over past 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO have declined by the specified thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 days as higher borrowing costs dampen corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS has increased by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening housing market that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where HOUST has been below 1400 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in the unemployment rate signals an overheating economy with aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% and UNRATE falls < 0.1% over past 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen by at least 0.25% and UNRATE has fallen by at least 0.1% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 days as manufacturing weakness signals an impending recession.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100.
